mutations.name: the act skips the digest check, so a changed read-back still posts

mutations.name: a head that moved past the page's is read back as ready
kills: prTaps.prepare on a PR page answers no-action for a head that moved past the one the page showed

mutations.name: the prepare runs with inbox actions off

mutations.name: an accepted merge drops its land run message

mutations.name: a replay reads as a fresh close
kills: prTaps.act on a PR page reposts the identical record bytes on a replayed confirm and shows already
